note: QR-5 (P5.4) — the plan-named known-word NEGATIVE fixture, the eighth of the plan's eight: a KNOWN word is never rewritten. 'pray' is in-vocabulary (corpus df > 0), so the OOV gate forbids correction — even though 'prey' sits one edit away. The exact undecorated chip label 'Shared word: pray' is the assertion: any rewriting or chip decoration ('corrected from ...') breaks exact equality and turns this guard red.

ACTIVE from birth: it pins behavior that is already true (correction must never fire here), so it protects from day one — pending status would make it decoration. The OOV gate is THE invariant of QR-5: wrong-word -> wrong-scripture is this engine's worst failure class, and the gate is what keeps a spelling feature from ever touching a word the user actually typed correctly.
